title: Going deeper: A repair the child can do
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Own impact, keep reasonable limits and create a concrete path back into relationship and learning.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The harm or disruption needs repair.
practice: choose a concrete repair that addresses the impact
principle: Move beyond forced words toward meaningful, proportionate repair.
nextSentence: The harm or disruption needs repair. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can choose a concrete repair that addresses the impact.
keyLearning: Move beyond forced words toward meaningful, proportionate repair.
